mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear at Verona Community Park, currently 58 degrees. We expect an overnight low of 51 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Plan Commission is preparing for an October 5th meeting to discuss multiple certified survey maps and site plans, while the city continues to promote ongoing initiatives like the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan and local park developments.

Your calendar is full of fun options, starting with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by Yoga at Insight Wellness and the downtown Farmer's Market on Tuesday.
In a notable weekly report, officers investigated a retail theft on September 21st involving a suspect who was later identified and cited for taking candy from a local retailer.

Today's flavor of the day was Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Since the store is closed for the night, we look forward to seeing you when they open tomorrow at 10 AM to enjoy tomorrow's flavor, Caramel Peanut Buttercup.
